description: Read a tool's current state (its sync snapshot) from a device. Starts watching the tool and returns the next fresh snapshot.

deviceId.description: The device to act on: its id from list_devices or from your instructions. Pass it whenever more than one app may be connected. Once a call names a device, later calls in this session use it when deviceId is left out.

timeoutMs.description: How long to wait for a fresh snapshot before falling back to the cached one.

toolId.description: The tool id to read state from.

name: get_snapshot
